not-yet.response: I remove sleep and finish everything tonight.
not-yet.why: Ignores capacity and basic needs; an impossible plan is not demonstrated.

assisted.response: A helper tells me to postpone the household task and restore my break; I do so.
assisted.why: The helper supplied the prioritisation, so the output is assisted even if feasible.

independent.response: I restore food, rest and a break, defer the household task and identify one manageable step on the form due tomorrow. I check the remaining form time and request support or clarification without assuming it. This is planning, not a diagnosis; persistent or urgent distress needs appropriate help.
independent.why: Shows capacity, basic needs, uncertainty and professional limits. Unfinished work can be a responsible result.

advanced.response: If the form takes longer than available capacity, I contact the verified service about options early and choose the highest-consequence step rather than compressing impossible work.
advanced.why: Revises the plan under changed workload and preserves basic needs.
